description: KYNX Unified v0.9.66 (Build 76 — Android & iOS): Fixed Android <-> iOS BLE GATT Radar discovery (removed iOS primary-ad overflow, serialized Android requestMtu/discoverServices/writeDescriptor handshake, added iOS didSubscribeTo & didFailToConnect + MTU-aware framing) alongside 720p60 HD calls & KYNX audio.
